description: When a manager submits the Referral request approval form, emails the drafted (or edited) request for a new referral to the patient or the GP, as chosen. The WorkQ item stays open until "Follow up referral requests" sees the new referral in Cliniko. Never sends the same request twice. "Don't send" closes the item.

flowIr.description: Triggered by the Referral request approval form: sends the approved request to the patient or GP and hands off to the follow-up check.
flowIr.name: Cliniko Automations: Send approved referral request

nodes.title: Load the manager's decision and the saved request
Note the failure on the WorkQ item
Send the request to the patient or GP
